policy: Merge original 5/5 or 4/5 diagnostics with honest passing stated controls and current checks. Retain any distinct scientific question or useful control; close only wholly useless or proved redundant proposals.
scope_note: Review of problem proposals, not authorizing algorithm/recipe/default/config changes from other toy-related PRs. All remaining proposals have recorded reasons to exist; grouping same-law controls does not justify deleting them.

records.title: Add CPU regression reproducer for unsafe generator LR release
records.scientific_question: Can one native SettleTest learning-rate release destabilize a settled stiff coordinate, while cancelling only that release and retaining releases on safe geometry provide the two causal controls?
records.scientific_result: NEGATIVE_DIAGNOSTIC_PASS; native controller instability reproduced; No claimed dataset/generator convergence or production optimizer qualification
records.reason_to_keep: Useful expected-failure controller unit with an isolated release intervention and a safe-release control; model failure is the intended diagnostic observation.
records.next_step: Merged the useful expected-failure diagnostic after the refreshed Python matrix and release build passed; a future controller change must separately address the strict XFAIL.

records.title: Circle transition toy with paired-error controller
records.scientific_question: Can independent local signed tangential/radial transition rows support the correct radius, direction and speed over 1024 true-environment closed-loop steps?
records.reason_to_keep: Distinct closed-loop signed motion and radial recovery question; an API blocker does not remove its scientific value.
records.next_step: Keep the useful task; isolate a current-API test adapter and check loss/update parity before capturing training. Do not merge the old whole branch or equate an API exception with numerical training failure.

records.title: MisGAN toy: full MisGAN (data + mask + imputer) on the 8D-lifted 100-Gaussian grid
records.scientific_question: Can complete 8D data and independent missingness be learned while sampling the correct missing-coordinate conditional posterior under MCAR20/50/80 and block masks, rather than merely producing a plausible projected marginal?
records.scientific_result: MEASURED; NO_FROZEN_GATE; Posterior/manifold deficits observed; no new predeclared binary model verdict
records.reason_to_keep: Independent missingness and posterior conditionality are distinct from an unconditional grid marginal; all four mask laws remain useful.
records.next_step: Keep all four distinct missingness laws. Freeze full-8D manifold/posterior tolerances against finite-draw Bayes controls, preserve the existing ungated observations, and resolve the current develop merge conflicts. Green CI and 100 projected modes do not establish conditional recovery.

records.title: Add GAN-only paired-residual convergence diagnostic
records.scientific_question: Does an odd learned critic push an exact paired prediction, and how do evenization and antithetic discriminator estimation differ in the three fixed native training profiles?
records.scientific_result: BOUNDED_DIAGNOSTIC_PASS; three trained profiles improve; No absolute density/routing/decoded-quality gate
records.reason_to_keep: Useful bounded odd-force/parity/estimator diagnostic. The affine bypass and missing absolute accuracy gate limit the claim but do not make the diagnostic useless.
records.next_step: Unchanged reviewed 4/5 head and all four recorded CI checks green. Merge the diagnostic/test only after refreshing against current develop; do not adopt evenization as a production optimizer result.

records.title: Add guided routed-convergence and exact-solution game toys
records.scientific_question: Does neutralizing fresh H/b remove the shared two-site particle disadvantage under four fixed judges while codes remain useful? The live head adds guided CFG=3 and unguided rotated teacher laws, plus a separate zero-update frozen-critic stationarity/attraction unit.
records.scientific_result: Old head bounded H/b diagnostic reproduced; LIVE_SCOPE_EXPANDED; Old signed endpoint reclassification PASS; 16 new guided/rotated saved deltas positive, but new source gates still unsigned at live head
records.reason_to_keep: Useful matched H/b intervention and guided/unguided negative control; stationarity versus attraction is a separate local question. Neither establishes the remaining full-Supra cause.
records.next_step: Repair signed benefit checks in all five old/new assertion paths, reject each harmful arm/judge control, retain independent source bindings and actual negative rotated result; check the repaired proposal head before merging.
